title: 5 Early Warning Signs Your Battery Might Need Attention
caption: As the temperature drops in Saskatoon, a weak battery can leave you stranded. Keep an eye out for slow engine cranking, dim headlights, the check engine light, a swollen battery case, or corrosion around the terminals. If you notice any of these, a quick mobile check can save you a cold morning wait. Regular testing helps avoid the hassle of a tow and keeps you on the road.
